title: Freeway Entrance: Match Traffic and Merge Into a Safe Gap
short: You want to join the freeway.
intro: You are on the entrance ramp. The blue car is on your left; the mirror shows traffic behind.
watchCaption: The blue car is ahead on the left. A clear gap follows.
safeCaption: Match speed. Signal and check. Enter the open gap.
unsafeCaption: Wait for space. Do not move in beside another car.
safeFeedback: You match traffic speed, signal, check, and enter behind blue without taking its space.

feedback.stop-ramp: Stopping in an available merge gap created a rear-end risk. Match traffic speed and merge when clear.
feedback.force-merge: You entered beside blue while trying to pass. Use the available gap behind it.
